scope: Verified architecture guidance, not a full systematic novelty review or literal reproduction

sources.title: Generative Modeling of Molecular Dynamics Trajectories
sources.evidence: Methods 3.2 and Appendix A.1 algorithms: alternating spatial and temporal attention, frame-relative representations and adaptive residual modulation
sources.adaptation: Fixed-site spin tokens in a registered crystal frame, graph spatial updates and temporal attention. No protein-specific IPA/torsions; not MDGen reproduction.

sources.title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
sources.evidence: DiTBlock adaptive LayerNorm and gated residual branches; source code inspected
sources.adaptation: Per-token normalization and zero-initialized scalar adaptive gates; spherical flow rather than image diffusion.

sources.title: Perceiver IO: A General Architecture for Structured Inputs & Outputs
sources.evidence: Section 3.1 and Appendix E: read cross-attention, latent processing, output query decoding
sources.adaptation: Eight learnable latent queries read the path tokens and write back to retained fine tokens. Regional graph pooling is our additional candidate, not a Perceiver claim.

sources.title: EquiformerV2: Improved Equivariant Transformer for Scaling to Higher-Degree Representations
sources.evidence: Sections 3.1-3.4: SO(2) convolution and representation-aware activation/normalization
sources.adaptation: Symmetry and normalization guidance only. Full higher-order irreducible representation network NOT implemented. Our registered-frame representation is different.

sources.title: Fast and generalizable micromagnetic simulation with deep neural nets
sources.evidence: Publisher abstract: U-shaped multiscale encoder-decoder approximates demagnetizing field inside LLG
sources.adaptation: Supports testing multiscale spatial communication for magnetism, but their task is a field surrogate, not a learned stochastic joint-path distribution. Full paywalled architecture not claimed inspected.

implementation_boundary: Bauer and triangular Co registrations only for physical runs; Cartesian 1D/2D/3D software tests do not prove physical universality. Fine/coarse path is one level, not an arbitrary recursive hierarchy. Separate model per Hamiltonian, boundary and temperature package.
